Title: Cookies policy
Content:
This Cookie Policy explains how Studio Soren ("we", "us", and "our") uses cookies and similar technologies to recognise you when you visit our website. It explains what these technologies are and why we use them, as well as your rights to control our use of them.

What are cookies?

Cookies are small data files that are placed on your computer or mobile device when you visit a website. They are widely used by website owners to make their platforms work, or to work more efficiently, as well as to provide reporting information.

Why we use cookies

We use first-party and third-party cookies for several reasons. Some cookies are required for technical reasons in order for our website to operate (we refer to these as "essential" or "strictly necessary" cookies). Other cookies enable us to track and target the interests of our users to enhance the experience on our site.

Types of Cookies we use

We categorise our cookies into the following groups:

  • Strictly Necessary Cookies: These are essential for you to browse the website and use its features. The website cannot function properly without these.

  • Performance & Analytics Cookies: These cookies collect information about how you use our website, such as which pages you visit most often. We typically use Google Analytics for this. All information is aggregated and anonymous.

  • Functionality Cookies: These allow our website to remember choices you make (such as your language or region) to provide more personal features.

  • Marketing & Targeting Cookies: These cookies are used to deliver content more relevant to you and your interests. They help measure the effectiveness of advertising and branding campaigns.

Specific Third-Party Cookies

Given our services in UX/UI and digital strategy, we may use third-party tools that set cookies, including:

  • Google Analytics: To understand how visitors engage with our design portfolio and services.

  • Hosting Providers: To ensure the stability and security of the site architecture.

  • Booking Tools: If you use our site to book a discovery call, these tools may set cookies to manage the appointment process.

How to control cookies

You have the right to decide whether to accept or reject cookies.

  • Cookie Consent Manager: You can exercise your preferences via our on-site cookie banner or settings link.

  • Browser Controls: You can set or amend your web browser controls to accept or refuse cookies. If you choose to reject cookies, you may still use our website, though some functionality may be restricted.

  • Opting Out: Most advertising networks offer you a way to opt out of targeted adverts. You can find more information at Your Online Choices.

Updates to this policy

We may update this Cookie Policy from time to time to reflect changes to the cookies we use or for other operational, legal, or regulatory reasons. Please re-visit this policy regularly to stay informed.

Contact Us

If you have any questions about our use of cookies or other technologies, please reach out to us: hello@studiosoren.com

Title: Privacy policy
Content:
This Privacy Policy explains how Studio Soren Ltd ("we," "us," or "our") collects, uses, and protects the personal data of visitors to our website, studiosoren.com, and individuals who engage with our services. We are committed to protecting your privacy in accordance with the UK General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the Data Protection Act 2018.

Who We Are

Studio Soren Ltd is the data controller responsible for your personal data. We are a limited company registered in England and Wales.

The Data We Collect

We may collect and process the following types of personal data:

Identity Data: Your name, company name, and job title.

Contact Data: Your email address, phone number, and physical address.

Technical Data: Your IP address, browser type and version, time zone setting, browser plug-in types, and operating system.

Usage Data: Information about how you use our website, products, and services.

Marketing and Communications Data: Your preferences in receiving marketing from us

How We Collect Your Data

We collect data through:

Direct Interactions: When you fill out forms on our website, email us, or contact us via phone.

Automated Technologies: As you interact with our website, we may automatically collect Technical and Usage Data through cookies and similar technologies.

Third Parties: We may receive personal data from third parties like analytics providers (e.g., Google Analytics).

How We Use Your Data

We will only use your personal data when we have a lawful basis to do so under GDPR. The primary purposes for which we use your data include:

To Respond to Inquiries: To respond to your requests for information about our services (our legitimate interest).

To Send Communications: To send you our newsletter or marketing communications, where you have provided your consent.

To Improve Our Services: To analyse how our website is used and make improvements (our legitimate interest).

To Fulfil Contracts: To perform a contract we have with you.

Data Sharing

We do not sell your personal data. We may share your data with third parties that help us operate our business, such as:

Service Providers: Companies that provide us with cloud hosting, email marketing, or website analytics services.

Legal Authorities: Where required by law, we may disclose your personal data to government or law enforcement agencies.

Data Security and Retention

Your data is secure in our Google Workplace cloud environtment. We will retain your personal data only for as long as necessary to fulfil the purposes for which we collected it.

Your Legal Rights

Under GDPR, you have the following rights regarding your personal data:

The right to be informed about how your data is being used.

The right to access your personal data.

The right to rectification of inaccurate data.

The right to erasure of your data.

The right to restrict processing of your data.

The right to data portability to another service.

The right to object to the processing of your data.

The right to withdraw consent at any time.

Cookies

Our website uses cookies to distinguish you from other users. This helps us provide you with a good experience and allows us to improve our site. You can set your browser to refuse all or some cookies or to alert you when websites set or access cookies.

Contact Us

If you have any questions about this privacy policy or wish to exercise your legal rights, please contact us at:

hello@studiosoren.com
